messages:
Incident Bot: PagerDuty page fired: PROBER-FANOUT-THROTTLE (incident: https://pagerduty.com/incidents/PD6X9Q)
Incident Bot: Triggered by synthetic-canary eu-west-1 / prober-group-3 → >20% of probes returned 429s in a 1m window. Auto-escalation will fire at 2m.
Samantha L: ack. I'm on it — taking lead for initial triage. :eyes:
Samantha L: quick status — probes started spiking 429s at 12:02 UTC. No customer 5xx alerts so far on the public APIs. Dashboards: small p95 latency bump.
Raj P: looking at prober logs now, pulling recent deploys. I see a rollout of edge-rate-limiter v2 at 12:00 UTC that changed per-ip concurrency limits.
Oncall M1: PD note: incoming PD escalation to L2 if not acked in 2m. Confirming who owns edge-rate-limiter.
Samantha L: Raj can you paste the prober logs snippet?
Raj P: sure — logs (excerpt):
```
[12:02:07] prober-3 eu-west-1 req_id=abc123 upstream_gateway=10.4.2.11 response=429 "rate limit exceeded"
[12:02:08] prober-3 eu-west-1 req_id=abc124 response=429
[12:02:09] prober-3 eu-west-1 req_id=abc125 error=E_CONCURRENCY_LIMIT
```
Raj P: looks like the new limiter drops bursts; prober fanout amplified the effect — multiple probes share identical source IPs in the pool, hitting the same rate bucket.
Alex T: tagging infra @alex — edge-rate-limiter owner. Can we revert or relax quickly?
Alex T: i'm here — confirming the rollout, we pushed v2 with a stricter per-ip concurrency cap (default 10 -> 4). I can roll back the change to 10 for eu-west-1.
Samantha L: good. Meanwhile, we should also throttle prober fanout to avoid slamming the limiter during rollback. Runbook suggests temporary backoff.
Samantha L: executing prober throttle now: `./proberctl set-concurrency --group prober-group-3 --region eu-west-1 --concurrency 1`
Incident Bot: Command executed by Samantha L at 12:05 UTC — response: OK. Prober concurrency set to 1.
Oncall M1: PD: Incident status updated 'acknowledged' by Samantha L. Escalations suppressed.
Raj P: confirming logs after throttle: 429 rate ~ dropped from 22% -> 1.5% in 2min. p50/p95 latency returning to baseline.
Alex T: rollback queued: rolling back edge-rate-limiter v2 for eu-west-1 now. ETA ~ 3m.
Alex T: rollback complete at 12:09 UTC. Monitoring.
Samantha L: re-enabling prober pool slowly: `./proberctl set-concurrency --group prober-group-3 --region eu-west-1 --concurrency 4`
Incident Bot: Monitoring window 10m started.
Raj P: after rollback + staged re-enable, probe failures flatlined. No downstream customer 5xxs seen, a couple of customers had transient increased latency but no errors reported.
Samantha L: status: mitigation applied (throttle + rollback). Impact: synthetic checks failing (observability only), minimal customer impact (latency bump for a subset).
Samantha L: action items -> open postmortem, add a preflight check to rate-limiter rollouts, update prober to randomize source IPs or use more egress IPs, add automatic backoff to prober on 429 spikes.
Oncall M1: created PD incident note and postmortem ticket: PMT-7892.
Alex T: will follow up with a revert-safe rollout plan and update changelog.
Samantha L: handing off to Raj for follow-up analysis. Raj — please lead the postmortem and timeline.
Raj P: will do. Saving logs & metrics, will paste findings to the postmortem doc.
Incident Bot: Incident resolved at 12:15 UTC (resolver: Samantha L). Closing PD incident in 5m unless re-opened. :white_check_mark:
Samantha L: thanks all. If anyone sees further probe anomalies, ping here and i'll re-open.
Alex T: noted — will add a canary for rate-limiter config changes in the deployment pipeline.
Samantha L: brief post-incident note: no customer-facing errors triggered, synth coverage did its job by alerting early. Postmortem due EOD tomorrow. :memo:
